title: atlax artifact list (platform/artifacts.yaml in the atlax repo)
description: The artifacts of the platform model, each by its repo slug and the git remote whose main is published. An artifact is a deployable repo (decisions.md 2026-10-31); specs, docs and tooling repos are not listed. Writer: atlax-agent, through a platform/ PR it merges itself (card atlax-agent G4). Reader: atlax-watch (claudecode scripts/atlax/watch.py, card atlax-agent G1): `git ls-remote <remote> refs/heads/main` per row, publishing a new sha from a bare mirror; a slug listed twice, or a row without slug or remote, stops the run. Every factory reads the same list, so any factory publishes any artifact. Sample: artifacts.sample.yaml.

slug.description: The artifact id: its repo slug, as its plant.yaml `artifact` and its artifacts/<slug>/ folder. Unique in the list (test.py checks it).

remote.description: A git remote the watcher can `git ls-remote` with the factory's own login (ssh or https). Its main is what gets published.

note.description: One line for people: whose it is, why it is not seeded yet.
